note: Configs for the two NEW runners required by A2 that do not yet exist as entry points on the 966-row author data. Both are BLOCKED_PENDING_PATCH.

nlinear.model: NLinear (Zeng et al., AAAI 2023) — subtract last observed input value, one linear map T->L per variable (channel-agnostic), add back
nlinear.reference_impl: scripts/innovation/backbones/dlinear.py class NLinear (verified against Zeng et al. in its own provenance block)
nlinear.optimizer: adam, lr 5e-4 (matched to MIFlu for a fair control; assumption label: baseline-relative lr not disclosed)
nlinear.gap_in_harness: NLinear currently runs ONLY via scripts/innovation/clean_runner.py, which is bound to the frozen 598-spec 1025-row registry and its own metric code. It cannot run on the author 966-row data under the train_miflu protocol without a new runner.

naive.last_value_naive: repeat the last observed input value over the whole horizon, per variable
naive.seasonal_naive: value 52 ROWS before each target week, per variable; clamp to window edge and record seasonal_reference_clamped provenance
naive.seeds_note: deterministic; computed once per horizon and mapped to seed cells (stochastic_seed_applicable=false)
naive.calendar_validity_on_966: lag-52 by ROW == 52 calendar weeks everywhere (966-row data is dense; no gap)
